The engineering report details failure counts across ten distinct classes, ordered by trial frequency. The most frequent issue is right output without a receipt, recorded in 23 trials under ticket OMN-19514. This is followed by wrong content accepted by the quality gate, with 18 trials associated with OMN-19199. Wrong task class selection from pasted words accounts for 8 trials in OMN-19523. Cloud quota exhaustion after local refusal appears in 6 trials for OMN-17193. Three classes share 4 trials each: valid answers refused by shape floors (OMN-19524 and OMN-19005), inability to execute test suites (OMN-19458), and mostly false code review findings (OMN-19457). No terminal before the time budget occurs in 3 trials for OMN-19441. Unmet repository lint or type gates also appear in 3 trials under OMN-19527. The least frequent failure is a bare one-word answer blanked, with 2 trials in OMN-19525.
